name: Blockyard Vanilla
author: accounts@playblockyard.com
description: Reviewed Minecraft installer; fails if the selected version is unavailable. EULA acceptance is separate.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
curl --fail --location --retry 3 https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json -o manifest.json
MANIFEST_URL=$(jq -er --arg v "$VANILLA_VERSION" '.versions[] | select(.id==$v) | .url' manifest.json)
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "$MANIFEST_URL" -o version.json
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(jq -er '.downloads.server.url' version.json)
EXPECTED_SHA1=$(jq -er '.downloads.server.sha1' version.json)
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o server.jar.part
printf '%s  server.jar.part\n' "$EXPECTED_SHA1" | sha1sum -c -
jar tf server.jar.part >/dev/null
mv server.jar.part server.jar
rm manifest.json version.json
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  printf 'server-port=25565\nserver-ip=0.0.0.0\nonline-mode=true\nmotd=PlayBlockyard Minecraft Server\n' > server.properties
fi

variables.name: Server Version
variables.description: The version of Minecraft Vanilla to install. Use "latest" to install the latest version, or use "snapshot" to install the latest snapshot. Go to Settings > Reinstall Server to apply.
